strings.guide.note.vendor-generic: These are the general instructions for this brand. Your menu may look slightly different.
strings.guide.note.unknown-model: We do not have instructions for this exact model yet, so these are generic. Look for the setting under CPU or Advanced.

strings.preflight.elevation.blocked: This change needs administrator rights. Run PC Orbit as an administrator to apply it.

strings.verify.unknown: Cannot tell - we could not read the result

strings.preflight.recoveryAvailable.warning: System Restore is off, so there is no restore point to fall back on if this goes wrong.
strings.verify.mismatch: Applied, but the machine still reports a different value.
strings.verify.unreadable: Applied, but we could not read the value back to confirm it.

strings.action.executor-unavailable: This machine has no supported way to make this change.

strings.transaction.verified-phase: Checked the result of this stage.
strings.safeApply.confirm: Can you still see this screen? Confirm within {seconds} seconds or we put it back.
strings.safeApply.reverted: No confirmation, so we put the old setting back.

strings.cli.result.heading: Result: {state}
strings.cli.result.noExpiry: Nothing expires. This plan will still be here tomorrow.

strings.cli.undo.heading: Undo {id} — {title}

strings.cli.undo.nothing: Nothing to undo: no transaction has changes in effect on this PC.

strings.cli.undo.alreadyRolledBack: Transaction {id} has already been rolled back.
strings.cli.undo.nothingChanged: This transaction never changed anything, so there is nothing to undo.

strings.cli.undo.excluded.heading: Stays as it is

strings.cli.undo.excluded.previousUnknown: {action} — the value before this change was never read, so there is no known value to restore.
strings.cli.undo.confirm: Undo {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} on this PC?
